title: Cambridge IELTS 20 Academic Listening Test 4 Part 1
description: Hội thoại đặt phòng khách sạn và dịch vụ du lịch chuẩn đề thi Cambridge IELTS 20 Test 4 Part 1.

lines.speaker: Speaker 1 (1)
lines.text: Test four.

lines.speaker: Speaker 1 (2)
lines.text: This is the IELTS listening test.

lines.speaker: Speaker 1 (3)
lines.text: You will hear a number of different recordings, and you will have to answer questions on what you hear.

lines.speaker: Speaker 1 (4)
lines.text: There will be time for you to read the instructions and questions, and you will have a chance to check your work.

lines.speaker: Speaker 1 (5)
lines.text: All the recordings will be played once only.

lines.speaker: Speaker 1 (6)
lines.text: The test is in four parts.

lines.speaker: Speaker 1 (7)
lines.text: At the end of the test, you will be given ten minutes to transfer your answers to an answer sheet.

lines.speaker: Speaker 1 (8)
lines.text: Now turn to part one.

lines.speaker: Speaker 1 (9)
lines.text: Part one.

lines.speaker: Speaker 1 (10)
lines.text: You will hear a man asking a friend for advice on things to do in the city with a family of visitors.

lines.speaker: Speaker 1 (11)
lines.text: First, you have some time to look at questions one to six.

lines.speaker: Speaker 1 (12)
lines.text: Now listen carefully and answer questions one to six.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2 (13)
lines.text: Sandra, I seem to remember you had some family visitors staying with you recently.

lines.speaker: Speaker 3 (14)
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Speaker 3 (15)
lines.text: That's right.

lines.speaker: Speaker 3 (16)
lines.text: My brother and his family were here a couple of months ago.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2 (17)
lines.text: Okay, good.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2 (18)
lines.text: Well, I wanted to ask your advice.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2 (19)
lines.text: I've got my cousin and her family visiting next month, and as I don't have kids, I've no idea where to take them.

lines.speaker: Speaker 3 (20)
lines.text: Right.

lines.speaker: Speaker 3 (21)
lines.text: What about accommodation?

lines.speaker: Speaker 3 (22)
lines.text: Are they going to stay with you in your flat?

lines.speaker: Speaker 2 (23)
lines.text: No, thankfully.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2 (24)
lines.text: There wouldn't be room.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2 (25)
lines.text: My cousin wants me to recommend a hotel.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2 (26)
lines.text: Do you know anywhere?

lines.speaker: Speaker 3 (27)
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: Speaker 3 (28)
lines.text: I do, actually.

lines.speaker: Speaker 3 (29)
lines.text: I always recommend people stay at the King's Hotel.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2 (30)
lines.text: Where's that near?

lines.speaker: Speaker 3 (31)
lines.text: It's about five minutes walk from Murray Station, so nice and central.

lines.speaker: Speaker 3 (32)
lines.text: It's actually on George Street.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2 (33)
lines.text: Oh, yes, I know.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2 (34)
lines.text: I think they're on quite a tight budget.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2 (35)
lines.text: So how much roughly is it to stay there?

lines.speaker: Speaker 3 (36)
lines.text: If you book a family room, it's about u00a3125 per night.

lines.speaker: Speaker 3 (37)
lines.text: My brother paid for two double rooms in the end, and I think that was around u00a395 for each room.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2 (38)
lines.text: Oh, that's not too bad.

lines.speaker: Speaker 3 (39)
lines.text: So how old are your cousins' kids?

lines.speaker: Speaker 2 (40)
lines.text: 12 and nine.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2 (41)
lines.text: So I want to organise some trips while they're here.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2 (42)
lines.text: I was thinking of doing a bus tour of the city centre, as none of them have been here before.

lines.speaker: Speaker 3 (43)
lines.text: Those bus tours are quite expensive.

lines.speaker: Speaker 3 (44)
lines.text: I think it's better to do a walking tour it gives you a much better feel for the city.

lines.speaker: Speaker 3 (45)
lines.text: There's one that starts from Colton Square.

lines.speaker: Speaker 3 (46)
lines.text: It takes a couple of hours and doesn't cost that much.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2 (47)
lines.text: Sounds good.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2 (48)
lines.text: I'll look that up.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2 (49)
lines.text: Thanks.

lines.speaker: Speaker 3 (50)
lines.text: If the weather's nice, one thing you could do is visit the Old Fort.

lines.speaker: Speaker 3 (51)
lines.text: You could get there by boat the whole trip takes half a day.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2 (52)
lines.text: That's a really good idea.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2 (53)
lines.text: I'd like to do that myself.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2 (54)
lines.text: And if the weather's bad, I was thinking they could go to the science museum.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2 (55)
lines.text: But maybe they could do that when I'm at work.

lines.speaker: Speaker 3 (56)
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Speaker 3 (57)
lines.text: Don't forget, it's closed on Mondays.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2 (58)
lines.text: They're here from Saturday for four nights, so Tuesday would be best, I think.

lines.speaker: Speaker 3 (59)
lines.text: And it won't be so crowded then.

lines.speaker: Speaker 3 (60)
lines.text: Saturdays are terrible.

lines.speaker: Speaker 3 (61)
lines.text: I took my kids to the exhibition on old computers there, and it was far too crowded.

lines.speaker: Speaker 3 (62)
lines.text: I wanted to go back, but it's finished now.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2 (63)
lines.text: That's a shame.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2 (64)
lines.text: My cousin's kids would have enjoyed that.

lines.speaker: Speaker 3 (65)
lines.text: There's another one starting soon on space, which looks really good too.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2 (66)
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2 (67)
lines.text: Well, I'll mention that to my cousin.

lines.speaker: Speaker 1 (68)
lines.text: Before you hear the rest of the conversation, you have some time to look at questions seven to 10.

lines.speaker: Speaker 1 (69)
lines.text: Now listen and answer questions seven to 10.

lines.speaker: Speaker 3 (70)
lines.text: Have you thought about where to take them to eat?

lines.speaker: Speaker 2 (71)
lines.text: Well, I really like all the food stalls at Clacton Market.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2 (72)
lines.text: My cousin's vegetarian.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2 (73)
lines.text: I know it's one of the best places for that kind of food.

lines.speaker: Speaker 3 (74)
lines.text: Definitely.

lines.speaker: Speaker 3 (75)
lines.text: And there'll be loads of choice for the kids too.

lines.speaker: Speaker 3 (76)
lines.text: You need to get there quite early, though.

lines.speaker: Speaker 3 (77)
lines.text: At the weekend, most

lines.speaker: Speaker 2 (78)
lines.text: of the stores stop serving lunch at 02:30.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2 (79)
lines.text: Good point.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2 (80)
lines.text: It's all going to need careful planning.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2 (81)
lines.text: My cousin said she'd love to take the kids to a show at the theatre, but tickets are so expensive.

lines.speaker: Speaker 3 (82)
lines.text: I know.

lines.speaker: Speaker 3 (83)
lines.text: But you can get some good deals if you book online with bargaintickets.com for the following day.

lines.speaker: Speaker 3 (84)
lines.text: On some seats, there's a 75% discount.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2 (85)
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: Speaker 2 (86)
lines.text: I must try and get some.

lines.speaker: Speaker 3 (87)
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Speaker 3 (88)
lines.text: There are lots of things you can do for free as well.

lines.speaker: Speaker 3 (89)
lines.text: No need to spend a fortune.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2 (90)
lines.text: Like what?

lines.speaker: Speaker 3 (91)
lines.text: They're coming next month, right?

lines.speaker: Speaker 3 (92)
lines.text: Well, check and see if it's the same weekend as the Roots Music Festival in Blakewell Gardens.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2 (93)
lines.text: R double o t s?

lines.speaker: Speaker 2 (94)
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2 (95)
lines.text: Check it

lines.speaker: Speaker 3 (96)
lines.text: out online.

lines.speaker: Speaker 3 (97)
lines.text: It's always a family friendly event and there's no entry charge.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2 (98)
lines.text: That sounds perfect.

lines.speaker: Speaker 3 (99)
lines.text: And if you're in Blakewell Gardens, climb Telegraph Hill.

lines.speaker: Speaker 3 (100)
lines.text: You'll be able to look right down on the port.

lines.speaker: Speaker 3 (101)
lines.text: Everyone's always really impressed because it's so huge.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2 (102)
lines.text: Oh, yeah.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2 (103)
lines.text: I've been meaning to do that for ages.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2 (104)
lines.text: I've heard the view's amazing.

lines.speaker: Speaker 3 (105)
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Speaker 3 (106)
lines.text: It's really worth the effort.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2 (107)
lines.text: Well, that's given me loads of ideas.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2 (108)
lines.text: Thanks so much.

lines.speaker: Speaker 1 (109)
lines.text: That is the end of part one.

lines.speaker: Speaker 1 (110)
lines.text: You now have one minute to check your answers to part one.
